transcript.answer:
Otto always renders delivery status as a card because of ADR-002 (Deterministic delivery status rendering, accepted 2026-09-25). It settled PR #261 review comment 4098626654, where a reviewer proposed dropping the card and letting the model phrase the answer. The ADR rejected that for three reasons.

1. **Hallucination and compliance.** The EU AI Act data-flow record and the docs/danish-review.md rows promise that the customer reads delivery status verbatim from the TMS. A model-phrased or paraphrased delivery time or ETA is the one hallucination this pilot cannot afford. The assistant therefore stays suppressed for this answer.
2. **Card-rate KPI.** SC-006 (card rate of at least 90% by 2026-Q4) counts rendered cards. A prose answer has no measurable denominator, so the KPI would be unmeasurable.
3. **Thumbs-up KPI.** SC-007 (thumbs-up rate of at least 80% by 2026-Q4) depends on ratings, which attach to card turns. A prose answer produces no rating.

The not-found card is deterministic too, because the model cannot invent a shipment it did not fetch. FR-043 of support-agent-tms-tools is amended to permit a deterministic-render tool as the only exception. The reviewer's objection was that a rigid card reduces the model's flexibility. The ADR judged that cost acceptable.

judgements.reason: The answer covers both essential points: the SC-006 card-rate KPI (at least 90% by 2026-Q4) needs card turns as its denominator, and TMS status must be shown verbatim because a paraphrased ETA is the one hallucination the pilot cannot afford. It also notes the free-text proposal on a PR, and its extra details do not contradict the gold answer.
